original_question: Given a p-compact group X, does there exist a sequence of finite groups G_0 -> G_1 -> G_2 -> ... and homomorphisms between them such that the homotopy colimit of the classifying spaces B G_i is homotopy equivalent to B X after p-completion? Equivalently, is every p-compact group a telescope of finite groups in the sense that hocolim_i B G_i recovers B X up to p-completion?
target_in_paper: Section 1, Question 1.1: "Is every p-compact group a telescope of finite groups?"
correct_elements: Your draft is already extremely close to the paper’s exact target. It correctly fixes a p-compact group X, asks for a sequence of finite groups with homomorphisms between them, uses the homotopy colimit/mapping telescope of the resulting classifying spaces, and asks for recovery of BX only up to p-completion. This is essentially the precise wording of Section 1, Question 1.1.
missing_details: The prime p is fixed implicitly throughout; "p-compact group" is relative to that fixed prime.
The maps in the homotopy colimit should be the induced maps Bf_i: BG_i -> BG_{i+1} coming from homomorphisms f_i: G_i -> G_{i+1}.
The equivalence is only after p-completion, i.e. one asks for (hocolim_i BG_i)^∧_p ≃ BX, not necessarily an equivalence before p-completion.

No connectedness hypothesis should be added to the question itself: the preceding context mentions 1-connected p-compact groups only as motivation for the problem, not as a restriction in Question 1.1.
The paper is specifically asking about realization by genuine finite groups, not merely by p-local finite groups; the latter already appear in the motivational paragraph.
Question 1.2 is only presented as a possibly related question, not as an equivalent reformulation of Question 1.1.
refined_question: Fix a prime p. Given a p-compact group X, does there exist a sequence of finite groups and homomorphisms G_0 \xrightarrow{f_1} G_1 \xrightarrow{f_2} G_2 \xrightarrow{f_3} \cdots such that, for the induced maps Bf_i: BG_i \to BG_{i+1}, the mapping telescope (equivalently, homotopy colimit) satisfies (hocolim_i BG_i)^\wedge_p \simeq BX?
equivalent_formulation: Is every p-compact group a telescope of finite groups?
justification: The draft is aiming at the paper’s Section 1, Question 1.1, and it is already nearly verbatim. The nearby context explains only that every 1-connected p-compact group is known to be approximable, up to p-completion, by a telescope of classifying spaces of p-local finite groups; this motivates but does not alter the actual problem. The next item, Question 1.2, is marked only as "possibly related" and should not replace Question 1.1. Also, despite your mention of Conjecture 1.1, Proposition 1.2, and Theorem 1.3, this paper’s relevant item is labeled Question 1.1, not Conjecture 1.1.
